entry.title: Version 5.0.37 - 08/31/2026
entry.content:
• Fixed an upload issue that could cause failed uploads to repeatedly retry and re-queue.
  • Very large file downloads are now resumable, preventing downloads from repeatedly restarting.

entry.title: Version 2.2.62 - 08/31/2026
entry.content:
• Fixed several upload issues that could cause repeated retries, failed chunks, or endless re-upload loops.
  • Very large file downloads are now resumable, preventing downloads from repeatedly restarting.
  • Fixed an issue where Selective Sync could incorrectly treat missing local files as deletions when re-enabling a folder.
  • Fixed several cases where syncing or downloads could become permanently stuck on large accounts or after local state errors.
  • Improved automatic recovery from corrupted Windows Sync folder metadata.

entry.title: Version 5.0.36 - 08/06/2026
entry.content:
• Fixed files that permanently showed "couldn't be opened" in Finder; affected files can now recover and open correctly.
  • Fixed excessive background activity caused by the app repeatedly retrying items that could not be fetched.
  • Fixed uploads stalling when a very large number of files were waiting to upload.
  • Fixed several sync issues that could cause deleted files to reappear or items to remain stuck.
  • Improved sync reliability and performance on accounts with very large numbers of files.
  • Fixed an issue where the app could retry the same operation indefinitely after certain server responses.

entry.title: Version 2.2.61 - 08/06/2026
entry.content:
• Expanded the range of supported characters in file and folder names.
  • Fixed several sync issues that could cause deleted files to reappear or items to remain stuck.
  • Improved sync reliability and performance on accounts with very large numbers of files.
  • Reduced background CPU usage on accounts with large numbers of files.
  • Fixed an issue where the app could retry the same operation indefinitely after certain server responses.
  • Added safeguards to prevent files from being removed if a local folder scan fails.

entry.title: Version 5.0.35 - 06/22/2026
entry.content:
• Added web-based authentication for sign-in and account creation, with automatic device provisioning.

  • Improved visual consistency across setup and account creation screens.

  • Ensured shared links to large folders include all files.

  • Resolved sync issues that caused some files to become stuck and reappear after being resolved.

  • Improved stability and memory management.

  • Eliminated re-index loops triggered by external USB drives after sleep or reconnect.

  • Resolved an issue that caused the app to hang when launched directly from a downloaded DMG.

  • Fixed icon layout issues in the Mac Ultimate Installer.

  • Corrected the "Learn more" link on the update screen.

entry.title: Version 2.2.60 - 06/22/2026
entry.content:
• Fixed several sync issues that could cause files or folders to become stuck or reappear unexpectedly.

  • Improved upload reliability and fixed silent failures affecting some large file uploads.

  • Fixed shared link issues affecting large folders.

  • Improved update reliability and fixed initial sync stalls after upgrading.

  • Fixed several stability issues, including re-indexing, launch, and memory usage problems.

  • Corrected the update screen help link.

entry.title: Version 5.0.33 - 04/30/2026
entry.content:
• Improved sync reliability in more upload, delete, and file registration scenarios.
  • Updated folder syncing, folder loading, and excluded file handling for better reliability.
  • Reduced setup time for accounts with large sync histories.
  • Fixed stability issues that could cause the app to close or restart unexpectedly.

entry.title: Version 2.2.58 - 04/30/2026
entry.content:
• Improved sync reliability when handling broken remote path entries, large file deletions, incomplete upload states, and files deleted from another device.
  • Reduced setup time for accounts with large sync histories.
  • Fixed stability issues that could cause the app to close or restart unexpectedly.

entry.title: Version 5.0.32 - 03/24/2026
entry.content:
• Removed inaccurate time remaining estimates.

  • Fixed a crash on OS 13. 

  • Fixed database errors that could slow down some uploads. 

  • Improved activity log performance and size management.

  • Improved upgrades from version 2.1.x to 2.2.x. 

  • Improved handling of the 50,000 file limit per folder

  • Fixed an issue where renaming or moving folders could leave locks in place.

entry.title: Version 2.2.57 - 03/24/2026
entry.content:
• Removed inaccurate time remaining estimates.
  • Improved activity log performance and size management.

  • Fixed an issue when upgrading from version 2.1.x to 2.2.x.

entry.title: Version 5.0.30 / 2.2.55 - 01/26/2026
entry.content: • Fixes an issue that was preventing updating from an older version

entry.title: Version 5.0.29 - 12/01/2025
entry.content:
• Changed upgrade behavior: when upgrading from 2.x to 5.x, files are set to cloud-only by default.

  • Improved CloudFiles reliability and performance.

  • Improved upload performance and reliability, including better connection reuse and more reliable uploads for 100 GB+ files.

  • Fixed issues with automatic updates, app not loading, and crashes caused by excluded/paused paths or too many excluded files.

  • Improved handling of cross-platform filenames to prevent name collisions.

  • Fixed an issue where deleting 50 or more files at once could fail.
  • Fixed an issue where some Unlimited accounts incorrectly displayed a “Storage is full” message.

entry.title: Version 2.2.53 - 10/01/2025
entry.content:
• Eliminated slow UI when launching on very large accounts (millions of files).
  • Fixed issue where the app did not always launch at system startup.
  • Account restore during install now completes much faster.
  • Fixed crash when the device ID was blank.
  • Improved lock handling to prevent potential syncing issues.
  • Updated OpenSSL to 3.x to address rare app crashes.

entry.title: Version 5.0.28.2 - 09/08/2025
entry.content:
• Clicking Sync folder opens the Sync folder.
  • Eliminated issues that would cause syncing to stall.
  • Ensure downloads don't block uploads.
  • Ensure shares cannot be moved into shares.
  • Ensure thumbnails are backfilling properly.
  • File upload stability.
  • Fixed run when computer is started.
  • Fixed storage is full error.

entry.title: Version 2.2.52 - 08/25/2025
entry.content:
• Handle 3010 install errors cleanly
  • Various fixes to prevent app from crashing
  • Fixed "Run when computer started" setting
  • Ensure downgrade from 5.x to 2.x provides correct error messaging
  • Expanded file event error coverage to improve app reliability and QA

entry.title: Version 5.0.27 - 07/25/2025
entry.content:
• Faster initial file loading on new install.

  • Broken Sync folder shortcut.

  • macOS 12.7 fix.

  • Issues where app had to be launched twice.

  • Stability issues related to locking.

  • Note: The 5.0.26 release was skipped

entry.title: Version 2.2.51 - 07/03/2025
entry.content:
• Issues launching the app.
  • Syncing status visibility.
  • Note: This is a Mac-specific hotfix for the 2.2.50 release.

entry.title: Version 2.2.50 - 06/02/2025
entry.content:
• Increased per folder file limit from 10,000 to 50,000.

  • More prominent error messaging with links to help desk for stuck files.

  • "core" no longer an excluded file name.

  • Events load much faster (Recents view).

  • Clicking on folders in advanced tab (selective sync).

  • Installer text alignment.

  • Improved load speed and reliability of the preferences pane.

  • Fixed various installation errors.

  • Reduced instances causing deleted files to reappear.

  • Copy-to-vault no longer causes syncing to pause.

  • Moving a share folder no longer breaks the share.

  • Deleted files no longer listed as files to review.

  • Fixed incomplete uploads data issue.

entry.title: Version 5.0.25 - 04/28/2025
entry.content:
• Increased per folder file limit from 10,000 to 50,000.

  • More prominent error messaging with links to help desk for stuck files.

  • "core" no longer an excluded file name.

  • Local generation of PDF thumbs.

  • Fixed various issues that could cause files to get stuck.

  • Fixed cases of files getting locked permanently.

  • Fixed instances where the “Remove Download” menu option was not working.

  • Folder icon shortcuts now work for excluded files and folders.

entry.title: Version 5.0.23 - 02/06/2025
entry.content:
• Improved load speed and reliability of the preferences panel.
  • The installer produced the errors “Unhandled unknown exception: terminating the application” and “Initialize failed: The initial message queue failed. Please restart your computer”.
  • Some PKG files were getting stuck during syncing.
  • Improved syncing when CloudFiles is installed on multiple devices, and when moving or renaming folders.
  • Reduced high CPU usage by CloudFIles when quitting the app.
  • Improved error messages on the progress tab.
  • Corrected a typo in the app installer.
  • Requirement update: As of 5.0.23 Mac CloudFiles will require OS X 13+.
